cs.t: That's what I built! It's a great case, the only components I didn't already have lying around were the motherboard and PSU. It's very well made, not as tight on space as I expected either. The only issue is as you noted, you have to be really careful with your motherboard choice if you want to use all 8 bays for a storage array. Another gotchas was making sure to get a CPU with integrated graphics, otherwise you will have to waste your pcie slot on a graphics card and have no space for the extra SATA ports.

I wanted a small form factor for my homebrew NAS and Jonsbo N3 is the case I ended up with a couple of years ago. I couldn't find anything smaller that would let me have at least 6 disks. The Asus ITX motherboard I bought second hand had only 4 SATA ports and I bought a m.2 sata adapter to get an additional 4 ports.
